  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [portfolio.setup, operating.reported]
  produces: [period.setup, period.reported]
  event_handlers:
    portfolio.setup:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: portfolio_id
            target_field: portfolio_id
      emit:
        event: period.setup
        fields:
          portfolio_id: payload.portfolio_id
          period_id: payload.period_id
          expected_operating_ids: payload.expected_operating_ids
    operating.reported:
      emit:
        event: period.reported
        fields:
          portfolio_id: payload.portfolio_id
          period_id: payload.period_id
          operating_id: payload.operating_id
          revenue: payload.revenue

portfolio-collector:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [period.setup, period.reported]
  event_handlers:
    period.setup:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: portfolio_id
            target_field: portfolio_id
          - source_field: period_id
            target_field: period_id
          - source_field: expected_operating_ids
            target_field: expected_operating_ids
      advances_to: awaiting
    period.reported:
      join:
        stage: awaiting
        members:
          from: state.expected_operating_ids
          by: payload.operating_id
        output: payload.revenue
        on_complete:
          advances_to: complete
        deadline:
          after: 5m
          from: stage_entry
        on_deadline:
          advances_to: failed

ingress-node:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [operating.report.triggered]
  produces: [operating.report.requested]
  event_handlers:
    operating.report.triggered:
      emit:
        event: operating.report.requested
        fields:
          period_id: payload.period_id
          revenue: payload.revenue

operating-node:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [operating.report.requested]
  produces: [operating.reported]
  event_handlers:
    operating.report.requested:
      emit:
        event: operating.reported
        fields:
          operating_id: payload.operating_id
          period_id: payload.period_id
          revenue: payload.revenue

portfolio-collector:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [operating.reported]
  event_handlers:
    operating.reported:
      accumulate:
        into: operating_reports
        from: payload
        key: payload.operating_id
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: period_id
            target_field: period_id
          - op: set
            target: entity.reports
            key: payload.operating_id
            value: payload
          - source_field: revenue
            target_field: last_revenue

scatter:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [batch.ready]
  produces: [item.requested]
  event_handlers:
    batch.ready:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - {source_field: items, target_field: items}
      advances_to: collecting
      fan_out:
        items_from: entity.items
        as: member
        emit:
          event: item.requested
          fields:
            member_id: member
            values: payload.items[?member].orValue([])
            index: fan_out.index
            count: fan_out.count
collector:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [item.reported]
  event_handlers:
    item.reported:
      join:
        stage: collecting
        members: {from: state.items, by: payload.member_id}
        output: payload.result
        deadline: {after: 5m, from: stage_entry}
        on_complete:
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - {target_field: ordered_results, value: join.results}
          advances_to: complete
        on_deadline: {advances_to: failed}

worker:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [item.requested]
  produces: [item.reported]
  event_handlers:
    item.requested:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - {source_field: member_id, target_field: member_id}
          - {source_field: values, target_field: values}
      emit:
        event: item.reported
        fields:
          member_id: payload.member_id
          result: payload.values
      advances_to: complete

account-node:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to:
    - account.registered
    - account.notify.requested
    - account.notification.completed
  event_handlers:
    account.registered:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: account_id
            target_field: account_id
    account.notify.requested:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: command
            target_field: last_command
    account.notification.completed:
      advances_to: completed

portfolio-coordinator:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to:
    - portfolio.opened
    - portfolio.account.register.requested
    - portfolio.accounts.register.requested
    - portfolio.membership.seeded
    - portfolio.notify.requested
  event_handlers:
    portfolio.opened:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: portfolio_id
            target_field: portfolio_id
    portfolio.account.register.requested:
      emit:
        event: account.registered
        fields:
          account_id: payload.account_id
    portfolio.accounts.register.requested:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: account_ids
            target_field: account_ids
      fan_out:
        items_from: payload.account_ids
        as: account_id
        max_items: 100
        emit:
          event: account.registered
          fields:
            account_id: account_id
    portfolio.membership.seeded:
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: account_ids
            target_field: account_ids
    portfolio.notify.requested:
      fan_out:
        items_from: entity.account_ids
        as: account_id
        max_items: 100
        emit:
          event: account.notify.requested
          fields:
            account_id: account_id
            command: payload.command

producer-node:

      emit:
        event: work.ready
        fields:
          work_id: payload.work_id

validator:
  execution_type: system_node
  event_handlers:
    review.reported:
      rules:
        - validate:
            set: matches
            input: {left: payload.left, right: payload.right}
            into: computed.validation.matches
        - when: computed.validation.matches.valid == true
          emit:
            event: work.accepted
            fields:
              proof: policy.business.description
              limit: policy.business.value
        - when: computed.validation.matches.valid == false
          emit:
            event: work.rejected
            fields:
              proof: policy.business.description
              limit: policy.business.value
        - default: true
          emit:
            event: work.rejected
            fields:
              proof: "invalid validation result"
              limit: 0

          - {source_field: value, target_field: value}

        id: still_registered
        check: _entity.current_state == 'registered' && has(entity.batch_id) && has(entity.item_id) && has(entity.value)

      emit:

        fields:
          item_id: entity.item_id
          batch_id: entity.batch_id
          value: entity.value

    g_a: first gate in the release chain
    g_b: second gate in the release chain
    g_c: third gate in the release chain
  event_handlers:
    step.a_done:
      sets_gate: g_a
      advances_to: stage_a
    step.b_done:
      guard:
        id: requires_a
        check: _entity.gates.g_a == true
      sets_gate: g_b
      advances_to: stage_b
    step.c_done:
      guard:
        id: requires_b
        check: _entity.gates.g_b == true
      sets_gate: g_c
      advances_to: released
      emit:
        event: release.ready

pipeline:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [stage.one_done, stage.two_done]
  produces: [stage.two_start, stage.complete]
  gate_state:
    g_stage_one: gate set when stage one completes
    g_stage_two: gate set when stage two completes
  event_handlers:
    stage.one_done:
      sets_gate: g_stage_one
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: result
            target_field: stage_one_result
      advances_to: stage_two
      emit:
        event: stage.two_start
    stage.two_done:
      sets_gate: g_stage_two
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - source_field: result
            target_field: stage_two_result
      advances_to: complete
      emit:
        event: stage.complete

retrier:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [retry.requested]
  produces: [limit.reached]
  event_handlers:
    retry.requested:
      guard:
        id: under_limit
        check: entity.retry_count < policy.max_retries
        on_fail: "escalate:limit.reached"
      data_accumulation:
        writes:
          - target_field: retry_count
            value: entity.retry_count + 1

gatekeeper:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [candidate.submitted]
  produces: [candidate.accepted]
  event_handlers:
    candidate.submitted:
      guard:
        checks:
          - id: depth_check
            check: has(entity.depth) && entity.depth <= policy.max_depth
          - id: count_check
            check: has(entity.child_count) && entity.child_count < 2
          - id: score_floor
            check: payload.score >= policy.min_score
          - id: no_flags
            check: has(entity.flag_count) && entity.flag_count == 0
          - id: name_unique
            check: query_entities(name == payload.name).count == 0
        on_fail: discard
      advances_to: accepted
      emit:
        event: candidate.accepted

gatekeeper:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [admission.requested]
  produces: [admission.granted]
  event_handlers:
    admission.requested:
      guard:
        checks:
          - id: capacity_check
            check: query_entities(current_state == 'admitted').count < policy.max_capacity
        on_fail: discard
      advances_to: admitted
      emit:
        event: admission.granted

lifecycle:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [phase.init, phase.activate, phase.start, phase.stabilize, phase.wind_down, phase.close]
  produces: [lifecycle.complete]
  event_handlers:
    phase.init:
      advances_to: setup
    phase.activate:
      guard:
        id: must_be_setup
        check: _entity.current_state == 'setup'
      advances_to: active
    phase.start:
      advances_to: running
    phase.stabilize:
      advances_to: stable
    phase.wind_down:
      advances_to: winding_down
    phase.close:
      guard:
        id: must_be_winding
        check: _entity.current_state == 'winding_down'
      advances_to: closed
      emit:
        event: lifecycle.complete

notifier:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [task.completed]
  produces: [task.logged, task.record]
  event_handlers:
    task.completed:
      advances_to: done
      emit:
        - task.logged
        - task.record

recorder:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [task.record]
  produces: []
  event_handlers:
    task.record:
      advances_to: recorded

dispatcher:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [batch.requested]
  produces: [batch.dispatched]
  event_handlers:
    batch.requested:
      count:
        items_from: payload.items
        store_as: entity.dispatch_count
      rules:
        - id: parallel
          when: payload.mode == 'parallel'
          advances_to: dispatched
          emit:
            event: batch.dispatched
        - id: sequential
          when: payload.mode == 'sequential'
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - target_field: dispatch_count
                value: 1
          advances_to: dispatched
          emit:
            event: batch.dispatched
        - id: fallback
          else: true
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - target_field: dispatch_count
                value: 0
          advances_to: dispatched
          emit:
            event: batch.dispatched

resolver:
  execution_type: system_node
  subscribes_to: [conflict.submitted]
  produces: [conflict.resolved]
  event_handlers:
    conflict.submitted:
      rules:
        - id: keep_first
          when: payload.strategy == 'keep_first'
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - source_field: value_a
                target_field: resolved_value
              - target_field: resolution_method
                value: "first"
          advances_to: resolved
          emit:
            event: conflict.resolved
        - id: keep_best
          when: payload.strategy == 'keep_best'
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - source_field: value_b
                target_field: resolved_value
              - target_field: resolution_method
                value: "best"
          advances_to: resolved
          emit:
            event: conflict.resolved
        - id: merge
          when: payload.strategy == 'merge'
          data_accumulation:
            writes:
              - source_field: value_a
                target_field: resolved_value_a
              - source_field: value_b
                target_field: resolved_value_b
              - target_field: resolution_method
                value: "merged"
          advances_to: resolved
          emit:
            event: conflict.resolved
        - id: unmatched
          else: true
